## From every conversation to enterprise action.

Service teams are measured on outcomes: resolution, satisfaction, sales, productivity
and cost. The data to improve them already exists, in every conversation with a person,
a bot or an AI agent.

That data sits in separate systems. Quality teams review fewer than 1 in 10
conversations, only a small share of customers answer a survey, and more of
the work now runs through BPO partners and AI agents, each measured a
different way. Leaders spend their time **assembling the picture** instead of
acting on it.

**AmplifAI turns that data into action in four steps:** gather the data, connect
the dots, harness intelligence and orchestrate actions. One orchestration
platform serves people and AI agents, so insight turns into action for both, and
results show up in the numbers you already report: sales, first contact
resolution, retention and cost to serve.

###### W H A T THIS GUIDE COVERS

**Customer analytics.** Up to 100% of interactions read for 25 signals, with
predicted satisfaction and first contact resolution, and the evidence behind
every number.

**AI self-service.** Chatbots, voice bots and IVAs scored on their own form
variants, independent of the bot vendor's reporting, and every self-service
contact followed to its outcome.

**Action across the enterprise.** Findings routed to the teams that can act on
them, inside the contact center and beyond it, and measured until the data
validates or fails the fix.

**AI controls.** Employee-facing AI on models AmplifAI hosts itself, client data
that trains only that client's models, and a person behind every decision.

## Everyone has a data lake. Almost nobody has it connected.

The signals that explain performance exist today. They are spread across systems,
sampled instead of measured, and rarely tied to the action that would change them.

###### 0 1 · SAMPLED QUALITY

### A thin slice of what happened

Teams review fewer than 1 in 10
conversations, so quality, compliance
and coaching decisions rest on a
sample.

###### 0 2 · SILENT CUSTOMERS

### Surveys hear from a few

Most contact centers hear from
customers through surveys, and only
a small share answer. The rest of the
customer's voice sits unread in the
conversations.

###### 0 3 · SPLIT WORKFORCES

### Every team measured its own way

In-house teams, BPO partners and AI
agents each report differently. Voice
AI vendors see what happens inside
their own channel, and the seam
between the bot and the agent who
picks up goes unmeasured.

###### 0 4 · INSIGHT WITHOUT ACTION

### A number, then nothing

Many platforms provide a number,
say it is bad, and stop. Without an
owner, a target and a measure of
whether the fix worked, the same
problems come back.

### Connection is the difference

A survey score on its own says little. Tied to the call, the reason for it, the
agent and the outcome, it explains what happened. AmplifAI connects every
interaction by customer experience, by advocate, by channel and across
channel hops, like a customer who starts with an AI agent, moves to a person,
then calls back.

**SECTION 0 3 · HOW A M P L I FA I WORKS**

## Four steps, one continuous loop.

AmplifAI runs one process on the infrastructure you already have, managing
performance across in-house teams, vendors, and human and digital workforces.

##### 01 Gather the data

Performance data, quality results, customer voice, every interaction channel,
the AI agent platforms, and the rosters and hierarchy, because an insight no one
owns never gets acted on. More than 150 source systems are already
integrated.

##### 02 Connect the dots

An end-to-end record of the customer context alongside every human and AI
touchpoint, by advocate, by channel and across channel hops.

##### 03 Harness intelligence

The harness governs the model: the prompts, the processing, the guardrails and
the verification. A least-cost routing engine sends each job to the right model,
so a short survey comment never costs what a long call does, and human
calibration keeps the signals, predictions and insights trustworthy.

##### 04 Orchestrate actions

The Orchestration Engine is the execution brain of the platform. It translates
intelligent signals into **deterministic business actions:** coaching and learning
for contact center teams, root causes for CX teams, product and pricing signals
for product and marketing, and compliance across every conversation.

### Solutions on one platform

###### CUSTOMER A N A LY T I C S

Reads up to 100% of interactions across
voice, chat, email, social and SMS for 25
signals.

###### PERFORMANCE ENABLEMENT

Models what high performers do, prioritizes
who to coach on which behavior, and drafts
coaching summaries.

###### AUTO Q A

Scores up to 100% of interactions against
your own evaluation forms, chatbot, voice bot
and IVA conversations included.

###### A I AGENT MANAGEMENT

Holds AI agents to the standards your teams
already meet: score, coach and govern them
in one place.

## Every conversation understood, with the evidence.

Customer Analytics reads up to 100% of interactions across voice, chat, email, social
and SMS for 25 signals, predicts satisfaction without a survey, and turns what it finds
into action that is measured until it works.

###### 2 5 SIGNALS, EVERY INTERACTION

Intent at three levels, from the transcript
itself. Sentiment and effort. Outcomes,
including resolution, escalation,
commitments and churn language. Agent
behavior: empathy, professionalism, solution
focus and engagement.

###### W H A T CHANGED THIS WEEK

###### PREDICTIONS YOU CAN AUDIT

Predicted CSAT and predicted first contact

## Self-service that resolves, measured on both sides.

Self-service only saves money when it resolves. AmplifAI scores what your chatbots,
voice bots and IVAs do, follows each contact to its outcome, and routes each fix to
whoever owns it.

###### 0 1 · SCORED I N D E P E N D E N T LY

Auto QA scores chatbot, voice bot and IVA
conversations on their own form variants,
independent of the bot vendor's reporting. AI
agents are graded on accuracy and resolution,
people on empathy and judgment.

###### 0 2 · FOLLOWED T O THE OUTCOME

###### 0 3 · THE HANDOFF MEASURED

Customer Analytics follows each self-service
contact to its outcome, contained,
transferred or abandoned, joined to what
agents did next, including where the agent
found a different intent than the bot did.

The handoff between AI agents and live
teams is scored on preserved context,
customer repetition and transfer friction,
with transfer rates tracked by contact type,
reason and outcome.

###### 0 4 · FIXES ROUTED T O OWNERS

Findings route to the remediation each
workforce needs: coaching for people, and
evidence-backed insight for AI teams, with
flagged utterances tied to the criteria they
broke.

### Across every vendor

Independent scorecards built from your data compare AI vendors, BPO
partners and in-house teams on quality, resolution and cost per contact, so
sourcing decisions rest on **measured outcomes** instead of vendor selfreporting.

## AI your review teams can examine, not just take on trust.

Four design choices shape the risk profile of AmplifAI's AI, and five principles govern it.

###### EMPLOYEE-FACING, NOT CUSTOMER- FA C I N G

The AI advises the people who run the
operation. It does not answer customers, so a
model error never reaches a customer on its
own.

###### SELF-HOSTED MODELS

###### YOUR D A T A TRAINS O N LY YOUR MODELS

Client data is never used to train models
available to another customer. Quality
calibration uses each client's own forms and
calls.

Language-model processing runs on opensource models AmplifAI hosts itself, currently
GPT-OSS 120b, in private single-tenant
Microsoft Azure environments or the client's
own environment.

###### ADVISORY O U T P U T, HUMAN DECISIONS

Scores, insights and coaching recommendations
are advisory. People review them before any
performance, compliance or corrective-action
decision, and every correction is logged.

### The framework: five principles

**Accountability,** with human oversight of every AI output. **Transparency,** with how
each AI system works documented. **Fairness,** designed to mitigate bias. **Privacy and
security:** single-tenant, encrypted, certified. **Continuous improvement:** monitored,
tested and refined. No AI-only output makes a legally binding or employmentimpacting decision.

###### THE CONTROLS REVIEW BOARDS ASK ABOUT

**Accuracy.** Validated against agreed success criteria in user acceptance testing,
monthly human audits of Auto QA scores, drift monitoring, and prediction accuracy
shown on the client's own data in the Trust Center.

**Personal data.** Sensitive data is redacted in the ingestion pipeline before analysis, and
data is encrypted with AES-256 in transit and at rest.

**Access and audit.** Single sign-on with Okta or Azure AD, role- and hierarchy-based
permissions, and logged evaluations, recommendations, user actions and configuration
changes.

**Certifications.** SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001 and PCI DSS, with compliance programs for
HIPAA, GDPR and CCPA.

AI governance documentation, the subprocessor list and audit reports are available through AmplifAI's security review
process. The two-page AI Governance and Controls Brief answers twelve common review questions.
